create_wikipedia_instance: create a Wikipedia instance that connects to MongoDB and accesses the wiki_redirects collection
resolve_redirect_names: resolve a list of Wikipedia page titles to their redirect targets using MongoDB lookup
review_wikipedia_class: review the Wikipedia class that extends MongoDataSource to resolve wiki page redirects
test_resolve_redirect: test the resolve_redirect method by passing a list of Wikipedia titles and verifying returned targets
refactor_resolve_redirect: refactor resolve_redirect to use a list comprehension instead of a manual loop for appending targets
